profile.headline: EdTech Entrepreneur
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Self-starter with broad experience in various business divisions and industries. Ambitious and enthusiastic, ability to learn and adapt quickly and provide results under pressure.  Continually adding to existing technical skill repertoire.  Seeking a challenging position within an entrepreneurial minded company to leverage my passion and creativity.

Specialties: Process design, web design, database architecture, requirements gathering, design translation.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and developed the extendable Laravel platform for Vivala and Revelist sites, launched 2015/2016.
Developed & maintained custom admin API tools (ie. Facebook Publisher, Facebook Ads A/B test, DFP API)
Implemented Prebid.js header bidding with GPT. Supported all aspects of GPT/GA for AdOps & Sales Ops.
Developed Node.js/Chart.js GPT/GA reporting tool for the AdThrive team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Restructured Cafemom/Mamaslatinas sites through redesigns and new enhancements (ie. Quizzes & Polls)
Wrote Perl automation to spin up Hive spot instances in AWS and R data analysis for the data science team.
Update & maintain acquired Drupal web property, BabyNameWizard.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Developed LAMP/JS “Yelp for everything” review service, ranging from films to people to concepts.
Conducted data scientist roles of data acquisition, organization, analysis and optimization.
Implemented server architecture transitions from self-hosting to Rackspace/Digital Ocean to Amazon EC2/S3. 
Performed Solr search engine installation and optimization for dynamic faceted search.
Developed brand via conferences and meetups, drove web site traffic growth, and sought seed-stage funding. Launched open beta release of the website in Sept. 2011.

positions.title: Requirements Analyst
positions.description:
Architected and completed transition of Business Continuity Planning (BCP) service of BPSi from Access database with fully customized per customer process to ASP.net library of templates & customized pages.
Managed outsourced Taiwan project manager at AvalonTech who oversaw China & Taiwan programmers.

positions.title: Process Consultant
positions.description:
Assisted in the design and process planning for the Quality Control and Packaging machine for their assembly line.
Used Autocad to display possible improvements to bottlenecks in the existing design.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Weflect.com is a social network review website that allows users to create their own categories, objects, reviews, specs, etc.
Formulating business plan and site architecture.
Wireframing and resource acquisition to build prototype.
Developed website prototype on in-house server.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Assessed the existing local art market of the Taiwan Rosestone. Met the key players and gathered data on supply, demand, and market size.
Consulted for a principle vendor in this art space with regards to their marketing strategies.
Took initial steps toward bringing this art form to the United States and opening overseas markets.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Supervised a 3 analyst team in market requirement efforts focusing on enhancements to SAP’s leasing solution, leading to Accenture-SAP discussions in Waldorf, Germany and a joint development project.

Planned, configured, and tested an install of SAP’s newest ERP2005 system. Led initiatives to prepare for SAP Sapphire 2006, including the development of a web UI using Webdynpro technology.

Participated in successful sale of a $100,000 leasing project to Volvo Financial Services GmbH.
Implemented SAP FI-CO at the Carolina CAT on schedule. 

Formally trained in SAP (Financing/Controlling, Business Warehouse, Asset Accounting, Lease Accounting)
